items.title: NIKE (NKE) Adds Alexandre Arnault As Investors Ask If The Turnaround Is Already Priced In
items.summary: Nike (NKE) just made a high profile boardroom move. The athletic giant expanded its board to twelve directors and added Alexandre Arnault from LVMH, even as it works through a difficult business reset. NIKE’s boardroom refresh comes at a challenging time, with the share price at US$35.51 after falling about 13.5% over the past 30 days and dropping 43.9% year to date.
